verdict.rationale: Sketch's developer site documents an official command-line interface, `sketchtool`, for creating assets with a single command, plus the `skpm` Plugin Manager CLI for publishing plugins. Evidence of depth is thin, a single-line description each. missing for 10: documented command reference/scope of sketchtool operations, evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Create assets with a single command with the Sketch command-line interface `sketchtool`.
Use the Sketch Plugin Manager `skpm` to publish a new plugin or an update of an existing one.
